title: Love
simplified_paragraphs: 女儿有两个苹果，妈妈问：“给我一个好不好？”
女儿看着妈妈，把两个苹果都咬了一口。这时候，妈妈很伤心。
但是女儿吃完后，对妈妈说：“这个甜，给妈妈！“
traditional_paragraphs: 女兒有兩個蘋果，媽媽問：“給我一個好不好？”
女兒看著媽媽，把兩個蘋果都咬了一口。這時候，媽媽很傷心。
但是女兒吃完後，對媽媽說：“這個甜，給媽媽！“
pinyin_paragraphs: nǚ ér yǒu liǎng gè píng guǒ， mā ma wèn：“ gěi wǒ yī gè hǎo bù hǎo？”
nǚ ér kàn zhe mā ma， bǎ liǎng gè píng guǒ dōu yǎo le yī kǒu。 zhè shí hou， mā ma hěn shāng xīn。
dàn shì nǚ ér chī wán hòu， duì mā ma shuō：“ zhè gè tián， gěi mā ma！“
english_paragraphs: A little girl had two apples. Her mother asked, “Can you give me one?”
The girl looked at her mother and took a bite out of each apple. Her mother felt sad.
But after tasting them, the girl said, “This one is sweet. It’s for you, Mom!”
english_full:
A little girl had two apples. Her mother asked, “Can you give me one?”

The girl looked at her mother and took a bite out of each apple. Her mother felt sad.

But after tasting them, the girl said, “This one is sweet. It’s for you, Mom!”
